title: Cross-border vape supply chains and online takedown measures
asked: Mr Jackson Lam asked how the Ministry works with overseas platforms and foreign jurisdictions to disrupt cross-border vape supply chains, and how effective blocking and takedown measures have been over the past two years.
response: The Minister said ICA, the Central Narcotics Bureau and the Singapore Police Force share information with foreign counterparts, and that joint HSA-ICA operations in 2025 detected 59 large-scale smuggling cases and seized around 230,000 e-vaporisers and related products. HSA works with e-commerce, social media and messaging platforms to remove listings, and with IMDA and the Online Criminal Harms Act Office to block vape websites targeting locals, with over 10,000 online advertisements removed in 2024 and 2025. On the supplementary questions, she said about 99% of sites taken down were on overseas platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WeChat, YouTube and Telegram, with the rest on local platforms like Carousell and Lazada, and described daily bot surveillance, officer checks of social media, public tip-offs and multi-agency blocking.

key_points.point: ICA, the Central Narcotics Bureau and the Singapore Police Force share information with foreign counterparts.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: engage in information sharing with their foreign counterparts

key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: in 2025, joint operations between the Health Sciences Authority (HSA) and ICA detected 59 large-scale smuggling cases, seizing around 230,000 e-vaporisers and related products

key_points.point: Over 10,000 online advertisements, including on messaging platforms, were removed in 2024 and 2025.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: Over 10,000 online advertisements, including those found on messaging platforms, were removed in 2024 and 2025.

key_points.point: HSA works with IMDA and the Online Criminal Harms Act Office under SPF to block e-vaporiser websites aimed at locals.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: HSA also collaborates with the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA) and the Online Criminal Harms Act Office under SPF to block e-vaporiser websites targeting locals.

key_points.point: About 99% of sites taken down were on overseas platforms such as Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WeChat, YouTube and Telegram; the rest were on local platforms like Carousell and Lazada.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: approximately 99% of the sites taken down are linked to overseas posts that appear on platforms, like Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WeChat, YouTube and Telegram

key_points.point: Surveillance is done daily with bots targeting commercial sites.
key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: On a daily basis, there is a surveillance done with bots to target commercial sites

key_points.point: Enforcement efforts will continue to be improved, and existing levers are in place.

key_points.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
key_points.quote: It is not just about the enforcement but also about educating the public
